planConformance: No dedicated W02b entry exists in plan section 5; this is a coordinator-issued cross-cutting correction (freeze section 17) resolving a conflict the W12 validator found. Its checklist is the 8 gates (B1-B8) in tasks/factory/w02b-GATES.md, all independently reproduced.

interfaceConformance.freezeSection17: Present, dated 2026-09-14, appended (not edited) after section 16. RunnerReference.manifestName lands exactly as specified.
interfaceConformance.ownershipDeviation: packages/@ezcorp/factory-sdk/src/{types,validation,references,index}.ts are Sol-controls-owned per freeze section 12, but section 17 explicitly names this as 'landed by W02b' - a coordinator-directed, disclosed crossing. Not a violation.

findings.title: manifestNameOf is not part of the SDK's public surface, contradicting the freeze doc and gate file's own migration instructions
findings.location: packages/@ezcorp/factory-sdk/src/references.ts:64 (defined, not exported); packages/@ezcorp/factory-sdk/src/index.ts:13 (barrel omits it); packages/@ezcorp/factory-sdk/package.json exports map has no './references' subpath either
findings.reproduction: echo 'import { manifestNameOf } from "@ezcorp/factory-sdk"; console.log(manifestNameOf("x"));' > w.ts && bun run ./w.ts  =>  SyntaxError: Export named 'manifestNameOf' not found in module '.../factory-sdk/src/index.ts'
findings.impact: Freeze section 17 and tasks/factory/w02b-GATES.md's migration note both tell W10/W11/W12 that 'manifestNameOf() in packages/@ezcorp/factory-sdk/src/references.ts derives the conventional name from a scoped one, for a pack that wants the default rather than a chosen name.' As written this is unusable from outside the SDK package; a pack cannot import it. It is not strictly blocking (the migration note's primary instruction is to hand-spell manifestName to the built manifest's own name), but the offered convenience path does not work as documented.
findings.suggestedFix: Add `isManifestName, manifestNameOf` (or just manifestNameOf) to the existing `export { ... } from "./references.js"` line in index.ts.

findings.title: The gate file undercounts the mechanical fan-out of the new required field
findings.detail: States 'Twenty-three test files and two web modules ... gain manifestName on a RunnerReference literal.' The actual commit c49d8e0fe touches 41 such files: 33 with a .test.ts/.spec.ts suffix, 7 non-suffixed helper/fixture files under src/__tests__/helpers/ that also construct RunnerReference literals (e.g. factory-attempt-launch-fixture.ts, factory-attempt-queue-suite.ts, factory-grants-suite.ts, factory-s3-publication-suite.ts, factory-release-authority-suite.ts, factory-execution-gateway-suite.ts, factory-validator-materials-suite.ts), plus 1 web source file (web/src/lib/factory/model.ts).
findings.impact: Cosmetic only; every one of these files was verified present in the commit's own diff and none of them changes gate outcomes (confirmed by the 302-pass focused rerun and the full lint/typecheck/coverage reruns). Does not affect verdict.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct the count, or drop the specific number and just say 'every construction site.'

gateIntegrity: No .skip/.only/.todo, no EXCLUDES, no lowered thresholds found in the diff. scripts/coverage-thresholds.json and scripts/check-factory-boundaries.ts untouched by this branch.
security: Every RunnerReference field, including the new manifestName, is sealed into referenceDigest (= sha256 of the whole canonical reference object), which is part of the lookup tuple for bindings/trust/intents/receipts. A receipt cannot be replayed under an altered manifestName (assertDispatchReady with a swapped manifestName fails factory_package_binding_missing, verified in src/__tests__/helpers/factory-package-preparation-suite.ts). No authority check removed; diff of package-preparation.ts shows only the three named comparisons retargeted plus one added bounds/grammar guard. No credential values in any receipt or log I inspected.
